runs.question: Which OMB memo currently governs how federal agencies acquire AI, and what happened to the earlier acquisition memo?

answer.text:
**OMB M-25-22 governs federal AI acquisition now.** It is titled *Driving Efficient Acquisition of Artificial Intelligence in Government* and is dated April 3, 2025. EXECUTIVE OFFICE OF THE PRESIDENT OFFICE OF MANAGEMENT AND BUDGET WASHINGTON, D .C . 20503 THE DIRECTOR April 3, 2025 M-25-22. Its purpose is to help agencies acquire AI responsibly, and it is issued alongside Executive Order 14179, Removing Barriers to American Leadership in Artificial Intelligence.

**The earlier memo, M-24-18, was rescinded and replaced.** M-25-22 states that it withdraws M-24-18, *Advancing the Responsible Acquisition of Artificial Intelligence in Government*, and takes its place. Because of that, M-25-22 is the operative acquisition guidance, and M-24-18 should no longer be relied on for current decisions.

The passages do not explain why the replacement was made, so I can't say what drove the change. They also don't show whether any later memo has modified M-25-22. The excerpts I had are partial, so I can't confirm every provision of the replacement.
